_readme: Machine-checkable facts for dogshow.lol, enforced by scripts/check_constitution.py in SCHEMESTUDIO/postwerks (constitution-sync workflow, daily).

Contract: every check pins a value that BOTH the code and constitution/facts.md must agree on. If you change the code value, update facts.md AND this file in the same commit — a red constitution-sync run means one of the three disagrees.

Check types: 'expect' = regex capture group 1 must equal it; 'present': true = pattern must match; 'forbid': true = pattern must NOT match. 'facts_must_mention' = literal substring(s) that must appear in constitution/facts.md. Patterns are Python re; 'flags': 'm' adds MULTILINE. All file paths are repo-root-relative.

banned_claims: phrases under the given facts.md heading are scanned for (case-insensitive) across 'globs'; 'allow' maps a filename to phrases permitted there (e.g. a legal page quoting a retired price).

link_targets._status: PROPOSAL, INERT AS OF 2026-08-22 — scripts/check_constitution.py in SCHEMESTUDIO/postwerks does not read this key yet, so it currently does nothing (the checker ignores unknown top-level keys; adding it cannot turn a green run red). Schema is a proposal — reconcile with the Postwerks side before implementing.
link_targets._why: Referential-integrity check, a class the existing value_checks/banned_claims do not cover: they assert what a page SAYS, this asserts that what a page LINKS TO exists. Motivated by two incidents on this site — 58 dead internal /breeds/* links (2026-07-25, 'Ahrefs crash', fixed in 9a899fa) and 15 more that regressed by 2026-08-22. Both were links to breed pages that had never been written. Deliberately site-agnostic: the property declares its own URL corpus, so the same check works for dollarbets/instaheadshots/any future site with no per-site code.
link_targets._relationship_to_the_link_rail: Complements, does not replace, seo_common.check_internal_links(). That rail is a live HTTP probe at GENERATION time and fails open on network trouble; this is a deterministic offline check at AUDIT time that also catches links written by humans, other tools, and future modules. Run both.
